title: senna angustifolia
intro: Senna angustifolia, commonly known as Cassia auriculata, is a plant species in the legume family that has been widely used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Senna angustifolia include its use as a natural laxative, due to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relieve constipation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its anthraquinone glycosides, which exhibit purgative and laxative properties. The bioactive constituents of Senna angustifolia include anthraquinone glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
